comment: Website-local: §9 flow 8 reverse (cloud→desktop). Seed an AUTHORITY scope (epoch 3) carrying a live dataset_sync_seq=100 minted during its authority period. Handing BACK to mirror bumps the epoch once (3→4) but must NOT delete the counter — applyHandover clears it only when a scope ENTERS authority — so the mirror period starts from a stable, untouched number space and a later re-handover resets it then. A repeated mirror handover is idempotent (changed=false, epoch 4).
